course_name_original: Astrophysique et histoire et méthode des sciences - Mad
course_name_en: Astrophysics and History and Method of Sciences
prerequisites: High school math basics: vectors, derivatives and integrals, trigonometry

learning_outcomes.text: Know the different objects observed in the universe, their organization and interactions.
Know how to determine distances and information about stars or the history of the universe from experimental observations.
Identification of a questioning within a disciplinary field (Propose analogies, make order of magnitude estimations and grasp their meaning, Manipulate the main mathematical tools useful in physics).
Analysis of a questioning by mobilizing disciplinary concepts (Mobilize fundamental concepts to model, analyze and solve simple physics problems).

Implementation of methods and tools of the disciplinary field (Interpret experimental data to consider their modeling, Validate a model by comparing its predictions with experimental results and Appreciate its validity limits, Identify sources of error to calculate uncertainty on an experimental result).
This teaching aims to introduce scientific and general culture and to raise students' awareness of the scientific approach.
Acquire scientific and general culture in order to be able to construct an informed reasoning to address a given problem.

syllabus_topics: Objects and architecture of the universe
The expansion of the universe and the Big Bang
History of the development of Physics from antiquity to the present day
Birth of experimental physics and the scientific approach
Discovery of the laws of Physics and their applications

assessment_methods.method: Continuous assessment for History and Method of Sciences component

assessment_rules: Assessment for both the Astrophysics and the History and Method of Sciences components is based on 100% continuous assessment. The syllabus does not specify how these two components are combined for the final course grade, nor does it provide minimum marks or resit arrangements.
